Amit Shah Engages in Multiple Engagements Across India

Union Home Minister Amit Shah has been involved in a series of engagements addressing various issues across India. These include reviewing disaster situations in states like Kerala, Maharashtra, and Gujarat, and assuring central government support. He also directed operational improvements at airports and discussed matters related to foreign exchange and border security with different delegations.
